extraction.name: VQAonline
extraction.description: The first Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset in which all contents originate from an authentic use case, sourced from online question answering community forums (Stack Exchange).
extraction.creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, and Danna Gurari
extraction.inLanguage: Multilingual (including English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Korean, Russian, Esperanto)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Created by scraping publicly-available data from the online question-answering platform Stack Exchange. Collected all examples containing a natural language question, a natural language context, an image, and at least one accepted answer.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Stack Exchange archive (publicly-available data from 105 topical sites)
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Removed visual questions with scores 0 or less for either the question or answer based on Stack Exchange's up-vote/down-vote feature. Excluded visual questions with multiple images (e.g., GIF) or with visual answers. Removed examples for which the image could not be downloaded from the provided link. Converted all images to png format.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For user intention annotations: Crowdworkers read definitions and examples for each category, then categorized the primary user intention. For human evaluation of models: Domain experts rated the performance of six model-generated answers per VQA as either incorrect (0), partially correct (0.5), or correct (1).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Amazon Mechanical Turk (for user intention annotations); home-grown, web-based interface (for human evaluation)
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For user intention annotations, agreement accuracy and Cohen's kappa agreement were calculated. Detected if annotations matched between two independent workers; if they did not match, a third worker was hired to break the tie by selecting one of the two provided user intentions.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 2 to 3 annotations per item for user intention; 1 annotation per model-generated answer for human evaluation
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Crowdworkers located in the United States who had completed more than 500 HITs with over a 95% approval rating. Domain experts located in the United States with at least a Master's degree in a field related to their assigned VQA topic.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-3.5 (used via a zero-shot prompt to brainstorm initial user intention categories), DeepSolo (state-of-the-art text spotter model used to detect text for all images)
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Understanding and identifying user intent can potentially help create human-centered VQA models for better user experience and facilitate the creation of datasets with better answers tailored to user needs.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The geographic representation of Stack Exchange is unbalanced, with more from countries like US, India, Europe and less from countries like Egypt.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas since VQAs are posted by Stack Exchange users with access to mobile devices and Internet. Geographic representation is unbalanced.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Validation, Testing, Few-shot learning, and Model Benchmarking for Visual Question Answering.
